title: VictoryHoldStarted
description: The coalition's victory hold began (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §9; ECONOMY EC-9, Q-TD-19, Q-TD-25; NX-412 part 4): on the first running tick it holds at least campaign.victory_node_frac of the strategic nodes. Followed by VictoryHoldBroken, or by CampaignEnded. Public: every side sees it (the hold enters the EnemyView, TD-2).

node_ids.description: The strategic nodes the coalition holds as the hold begins, ascending, no duplicates (producer).

ends_at_tick.description: The running tick on which the victory comes if the hold is not broken (campaign clock, like ObjectiveAnnounced.deadline_tick, not a Tick).
